result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but there are a few visual issues: restaurant names are truncated/clipped at the right edge in the horizontal carousel ('Trattoria Piccol' and 'Tokumaru Ramer'), which looks broken and harms readability.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third card's title 'Trattoria Piccol' is cut off at the right screen edge with no visible affordance or padding, making it look broken rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add right-edge padding or a peek/fade gradient to indicate horizontal scrollability, and ensure card titles use ellipsis truncation within their card bounds instead of clipping at the viewport edge.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramer' appears truncated (likely 'Tokumaru Ramen') with the final letter clipped, reducing readability of the listing title.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to a second line or apply proper ellipsis truncation so the full name is either shown or clearly indicated as truncated.

issues.description: The category filter chips row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') is cut off at the right edge with a partially visible chip, giving no scroll hint.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle fade or scroll indicator on the right edge to communicate that more categories are available via horizontal scrolling.
